description_en: Retrieves an available CIDR block from an IPAM pool
description_zh: 获取IPAM地址池可用的CIDR地址段
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam get-ipam-pool-next-available-cidr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-id ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIpamPoolNextAvailableCidr

parameters.help_en:
The region of the IPAM pool.

If the IPAM pool has a region property, this parameter specifies the region where the pool is active. If the IPAM pool does not have a region property, this parameter specifies the managed region of IPAM
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM地址池所在地域。
当IPAM地址池具备地域属性时，该参数为IPAM地址池生效地域；当IPAM地址池不具备地域属性时，该参数为IPAM托管地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block to be allocated.

You must specify CidrBlock or CidrMask
parameters.help_zh:
需要分配的CIDR。

CidrBlock、CidrMask至少输入一个
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The mask length of the CIDR block to be allocated.

You must specify CidrBlock or CidrMask
parameters.help_zh:
需要分配的CIDR掩码长度。
CidrBlock、CidrMask至少输入一个
parameters.name: cidr_mask

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
